court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Secretary, Department of Co-operative Societies, Govt. of Tamil Nadu and Others
advocates: For RR1 to 3: Mr. L.P. Shanmugasundaram, Special Govt. Pleader (Co-op.)
judgment_text:
Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to consider the petitioner's representation dated 23.11.2019 consequently direct the 3rd respondent to issue new voter list for the Karthikeyapuram Cooperative Building Society (Regn. No. JJ 345), No. 1/700A, II Cross Street, Karthikeyapuram, Chennai-91 to conduct free and fair election.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

T.S. Sivagnanam, J.:— Heard Mr. S.N. Subramani, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. L.P. Shanmugasundaram, learned Special Government Pleader accepting notice on behalf of respondents 1 to 3.

2. With consent on either side, this writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

3. The petitioner seeks for a direction upon the respondents to consider his representation dated 23.11.2019, and issue a new voter list.

4. This prayer cannot be acceded to because as per the election schedule/notification, dated 09.11.2019, the last date for submission of objections to a voter list is on 20.11.2019. Thereafter, the Election Officer has to consider the objections and finalize the voter list by 22.11.2019 between 10:00 a.m. and 04:00 p.m. and publish the final voter list on 22.11.2019 at 05:00 p.m. This process has been followed and the voter list has been published and 11 Board of Directors have been elected, vide proceedings dated 29.11.2019. At this juncture, no direction can be issued to publish a fresh voter list because, the petitioner has not given the objections within the time limit prescribed under the notification. However, this will not prevent the petitioner from invoking other remedies available to him under the law challenging the election of candidates.

5. With the above observations, this writ petition stands disposed of. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
